imports.service: CreateManifestCommandSchema, RenderManifestSchema, IdSchema, type CreateManifestCommand/RenderManifest/Project/Take/Asset/Approval from ../../production/contracts; ProductionApplicationError, type ProductionErrorCode from ../../production/errors; hashCanonicalJson from ../../production/hash; serializeAudioTimeline (READ-ONLY) from ../../production/audio; latestMatchingApproval from ../../production/approval-policy; computeTakeApprovalHash from ../../production/approval; shotsCompatibleWithStory from ../../production/revisions; type ProductionStore from ../../repositories/production/ports. approval.ts transitively imports computeAnchorApprovalHash from lib/jobs/production/queue (existing accepted pattern, takes.ts:27) — offline at import time.

types: MANIFEST_SAMPLES_PER_FRAME = 2000 (literal const per ARCHITECTURE.md:49; all conversions integer-only, safe-integer checked, never floating-point seconds)

ManifestShotSource = Readonly<{ shotRevisionId, shotHash, takeId, takeInputsHash, assetId, assetSha256, assetWidth, assetHeight, actualFrames, startFrame, endFrame, crop: {x,y,width,height}, transition: ManifestTransition }>

ManifestCompileModel = Readonly<{ projectId, storyRevisionId, storyHash, shotPlanRevisionId, shotPlanHash, animaticRevisionId, animaticHash, audioMixRevisionId, audioMixHash, profile (RenderProfile['profile'] shape), shots: readonly ManifestShotSource[], audioCues: readonly AudioCue[], captionCues: [], totalFrames, totalAudioSamples, selectionVersion, masteringRecipeVersion: 1 }>

manifestInputsHash(model): SHA-256 via hashCanonicalJson of { recipeVersion:1, masteringRecipeVersion, projectId, storyRevisionId, storyHash, shotPlanRevisionId, shotPlanHash, animaticRevisionId, animaticHash, selectionVersion, profile, shots:[{shotRevisionId,shotHash,takeId,takeInputsHash,assetSha256,startFrame,endFrame,crop,transition}] in plan order, crossfadeFrames:8, audioMixRevisionId, audioMixHash, audioCues:[full AudioCue content fields incl. gainDb, in mix revision order], captionCues:[] }. Excludes manifest id, createdAt, and every field not semantically pinned. Deterministic across object key order by construction.

compileManifestTimeline(shots, options:{expectedTotalFrames?}): pure; per shot validate 0<=startFrame<endFrame<=actualFrames (half-open [start,end)), crop 0<=x, 0<=y, width>0, height>0, x+width<=assetWidth, y+height<=assetHeight, assetWidth/Height positive integers (null dims fail closed), transition 'crossfade' only when a following shot exists (last shot must be 'cut'), safe-integer sums; totalFrames = sum(endFrame-startFrame) - 8 per internal crossfade boundary; expectedTotalFrames must equal totalFrames exactly else INVALID_INPUT naming computed vs approved total

validateAudioExactness(totalFrames, cues, options:{sampleRate:48000}): totalSamples = totalFrames*2000 (safe-integer); every cue timelineEndSample = timelineStartSample+(sourceEndSample-sourceStartSample) <= totalSamples else fail naming the cue id; output totalEndSample mirrors SerializedAudioTimeline.totalEndSample

buildRenderProfile(profile: ProductionProfile): frozen object parsed through RenderProfileSchema — id `render-profile-${profile.id}`, aspect=profile.format, 1080x1920 (9:16) or 1920x1080 (16:9), fps 24, videoCodec 'h264', pixelFormat 'yuv420p', audioCodec 'aac', sampleRate 48000
compilerProtocol: compileManifest(store, rawCommand, options:{now?}={}): {manifest, created} — SYNCHRONOUS, all work inside ONE store.transaction, mirroring saveAudioMix (lib/services/production/audio.ts:39-85). Validate via CreateManifestCommandSchema.safeParse; safe-integer now.

Load and bind the active snapshot: getProject -> UNKNOWN_REFERENCE if absent; story=getStoryRevision(project.activeStoryRevisionId), plan=getShotPlanRevision(command.shotPlanRevisionId), animatic=getAnimaticRevision(command.animaticRevisionId); require plan.id===project.activeShotPlanRevisionId AND animatic.shotPlanRevisionId===plan.id AND plan.storyRevisionId===story.id AND all belong to the project, else STALE_REVISION.
Selection snapshot CAS: command.expectedSelectionVersion === project.takeSelectionVersion else STALE_REVISION; duplicate takeIds in command reject INVALID_INPUT.

Per shot, in plan.orderedShotRevisionIds order (never command order): shot=getShotRevision(id); selection=getTakeSelection(project.id, shot.shotId); selection.takeId non-null AND member of command.selectedTakeIds; the SET of command.selectedTakeIds must exactly equal the set of current selection takeIds across all plan shots (no extras/substitution) else STALE_REVISION; take=getTake(selection.takeId) with take.shotRevisionId===shot.id else STALE_REVISION.

Accepted-matching take: latestMatchingApproval(read.listApprovals('take', take.id), 'take', take.id, computeTakeApprovalHash(read, take)) non-null else APPROVAL_REQUIRED (policy proven at takes.ts:122-124 — re-implement against domain helpers, do NOT import takes.ts). Asset pin: getAsset(take.assetId) exists, mime startsWith 'video/', frames non-null AND === take.actualFrames else MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE; asset.width/height non-null positive else MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE.

Story compatibility (C11 Binding ADR): when shot.storyRevisionId !== story.id evaluate shotsCompatibleWithStory exactly as proven at takes.ts:174-180 (descending lineage walk bounded 10_000, selectedCanonRevisions from project.activeCanonRevisionIds, continuation valid iff plan predecessor matches) else APPROVAL_REQUIRED. Story + animatic current approvals required via latestMatchingApproval(..., 'story', story.id, story.contentHash) and (..., 'animatic', animatic.id, animatic.contentHash) else APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

v1 defaults (command carries no trim/crop/transition fields, contracts.ts:781-785): trim=[0, shot.targetFrames) requiring take.actualFrames>=shot.targetFrames (short take blocks — never pad/loop/freeze silently; longer output trimmed to approved length); crop={x:0,y:0,width:asset.width,height:asset.height}; transition='cut' for every shot. The DOMAIN validates arbitrary legal trims/crops/crossfades so full C11 can surface them without recipe change.

Timeline: totalFrames from compileManifestTimeline with expectedTotalFrames=animatic.totalFrames. Audio: command.audioMixRevisionId===null -> audioCues=[] (legal; narration/music/SFX is a pilot/C12 gate, not G07). Else mix=getAudioMixRevision; require mix.id===project.activeAudioMixRevisionId, mix.projectId===project.id, mix.storyRevisionId===story.id else STALE_REVISION; latestMatchingApproval(listApprovals('audio', mix.id), 'audio', mix.id, mix.contentHash) non-null else APPROVAL_REQUIRED; revalidate every cue asset exists with non-null audioSamples and sha256 else MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE; copy mix.cues verbatim; run serializeAudioTimeline(mix, DEFAULT_AUDIO_OVERLAP_POLICY) READ-ONLY and validateAudioExactness(totalFrames, mix.cues).

Persist: inputsHash=manifestInputsHash(model); id=manifestId(inputsHash); existing=tx.getManifest(id) -> return {manifest:existing, created:false} (idempotent recompile, identical fingerprint). Else tx.insertManifest(RenderManifestSchema.parse({version:1, id, projectId, storyRevisionId:story.id, shotPlanRevisionId:plan.id, animaticRevisionId:animatic.id, audioMixRevisionId:command.audioMixRevisionId, profile, shots (plan order), audioCues, captionCues:[], inputsHash, createdAt:now})). Any failure throws before insert — zero writes on failure.

Fail-closed everywhere: typed ProductionApplicationError among INVALID_INPUT/UNKNOWN_REFERENCE/STALE_REVISION/APPROVAL_REQUIRED/MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE, each message naming the shotRevisionId/cueId/assetId at fault. No defaults for missing facts; no silent placeholders; never a provider or FFmpeg call; nothing async.

minimalTests.name: C11-PRE manifest fingerprint and timeline arithmetic are deterministic and fail closed
minimalTests.checks: Same fixture inputs give the same manifestInputsHash regardless of input key order (build twice with shuffled keys); hash changes when any pinned semantic input changes (trim, crop, transition, gainDb, cue text, assetSha256, profile, masteringRecipeVersion) and does not change when id/createdAt change; illegal trim (endFrame>actualFrames, endFrame<=startFrame, negative), crop outside bounds, null source dims, crossfade on last shot, expectedTotalFrames mismatch each reject naming the shot; crossfade subtracts exactly 8 frames per internal boundary; all arithmetic integer/safe.

minimalTests.name: C11-PRE audio exactness is integer-exact against the video timeline
minimalTests.checks: totalSamples=totalFrames*2000 exactly; cue ending exactly at totalSamples passes; one sample past rejects naming the cue id; totalEndSample matches accepted serializeAudioTimeline ordering; mixed frame counts never produce fractional samples.

minimalTests.name: C11-PRE compiler pins only accepted matching selections with zero writes on failure
minimalTests.checks: Real SQLite fixture (openProductionStore + reopen pattern): approved story+animatic, completed take job with current take approval and selection, approved audio mix -> compile returns manifest pinning exact revision IDs/take IDs/cue IDs/asset hashes/profile/inputsHash, persisted and readable after close/reopen. Negatives each reject with the stated error code AND leave manifest count unchanged: stale expectedSelectionVersion; command take set != current selection set; take whose latest approval is a later rejection; missing/stale audio-mix approval; mix bound to a different story revision; take asset frames !== actualFrames; shot outside the selected plan.

minimalTests.name: C11-PRE recompile determinism and canon-only successor compatibility
minimalTests.checks: Recompiling from identical fixture inputs returns created:false with a byte-identical manifest and same inputsHash; a canon-only approved story successor whose shots satisfy shotsCompatibleWithStory compiles; a successor with changed script/beats on the same shot rejects APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
